variables.label: GAIA2 runtime policy
variables.description: Bounded event, recovery, write, A2A, and observation-noise policy; never contains evaluator truth.

variables.label: GAIA2 correction policy
variables.description: Answer-blind correction limits. Correction replays use a clean session and never add pass@5 attempts.

variables.label: GAIA2 scenario state
variables.description: Safe scenario identity and agent-visible capability metadata for the current session.

variables.label: GAIA2 virtual clock state
variables.description: Checkpointable virtual time and pending waits; wall-clock sleeps are not task truth.

variables.label: GAIA2 event state
variables.description: Consumed and pending event occurrences with dependency and deduplication metadata.

variables.label: GAIA2 attempt state
variables.description: Current attempt identity and lifecycle. Experiment-level pass@5 state is kept outside Prompt Variables.

variables.label: GAIA2 write state
variables.description: Mutation-key and read-back state; unknown non-idempotent writes are never replayed automatically.

variables.label: Confirmed historical mutation receipts
variables.description: Bounded summary of trusted successful native mutations, never a claim about current state or task completion.

variables.label: GAIA2 replan state
variables.description: Parent/child plan lineage and invalidated steps after environment changes.

variables.label: GAIA2 observation state
variables.description: Native evidence ledger with independent freshness, query coverage identity and presentation visibility. Raw observations stay in artifacts; harness summaries are bounded.

variables.label: GAIA2 information-noise state
variables.description: Profile, independent seed, injection decisions, deduplicated records, conflicts, quarantined results, and schedule hash.

variables.label: GAIA2 observable progress
variables.description: Finite repeated-result and blocked-action counter. A recovery recommendation never claims official completion.

variables.label: GAIA2 actual action ledger
variables.description: Bounded, answer-blind record of actual native action counts and outcomes, including successful/failed/unknown separation. It never contains expected answers or infers task completion.

variables.label: GAIA2 action reconciliation context
variables.description: Bounded actual-action summary for Actor reconciliation; it never supplies expected actions or completion authority.

variables.label: GAIA2 exact entity evidence
variables.description: Opt-in native deletion and exact-entity absence proofs; local receipt identity is not a native entity version and never resolves unknown writes.

variables.label: GAIA2 exact entity proof summary
variables.description: Independent bounded explanation of trusted absence proofs; original native errors remain unchanged.

variables.label: GAIA2 task completion obligations
variables.description: Opt-in user-bound wait obligations; signals never establish task success.

variables.label: GAIA2 independent wait obligation summary
variables.description: Independent durable source, deadline and notification guidance; never overwrites evidence context or infers completion from controller signals.

variables.label: GAIA2 Actor-owned action reconciliation
variables.description: Optional Actor-declared, user-bound action/count/field reconciliation; runtime uses only Host-derived success and argument digests and never infers expected actions or reads an Oracle.

variables.label: GAIA2 action reconciliation summary
variables.description: Bounded Actor-declared obligations compared with successful complete native calls; failed/unknown/omitted evidence remains diagnostic and enforce mode is conservative.

variables.label: GAIA2 business-window obligations
variables.description: Trusted ARE-clock window lifecycle and separated SDK/wait/outer budgets. Pending or expired windows are not business completion.

variables.label: GAIA2 trusted window registration
variables.description: Host-bound, source-anchored window proposal. Read-only input for the registration Hook; never supplied by Actor text.

variables.label: GAIA2 business-window context
variables.description: Bounded lifecycle summary for time-window obligations; never converts a timeout, scan budget, or candidate into success.

variables.label: GAIA2 conflict confirmation plan
variables.description: Trusted blocked-action identity and bounded exact-query read confirmation requests. Clear is gate permission, never proof of an executed write.

variables.label: GAIA2 independent conflict context
variables.description: Exact-query recovery instructions kept separate from generic replanning context; never authorizes a native mutation.

variables.label: GAIA2 built-in wait controller
variables.description: Opt-in trusted controller state; ARE owns scene time. Signals request model judgment and never prove business success.

variables.label: GAIA2 temporal controller context
variables.description: Independent bounded signal summary; does not overwrite evidence, write-risk, or replanning context.

variables.label: GAIA2 runtime context
variables.description: Bounded, answer-blind runtime summary injected into the actor Loop.
